# Frontend dependencies by layer

Approved under the [2026-10-26 ruling](../quality/dependency-ruling-2026-10-26.md). Each dependency has one home layer; explicitly listed outer-ring and test uses below are limited to that dependency's job and exact users. Existing out-of-scope declarations remain findings in the [register](../quality/dependency-register.md), not new exceptions. Domain/entities and use cases remain independent of framework types. Existing layer-boundary gates stay in force; approval enforcement is a later slice.

| Dependency | Home layer | Allowed users and use layers | Approving ruling | Exit plan |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action:actions/checkout` | CI/supply chain | CI/supply chain: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/codeql.yml`, `.github/workflows/platform-negative-signer.yml`, `.github/workflows/platform.yml`, `.github/workflows/release-admission.yml`, `.github/workflows/workflows-check.yml` | [Delegated STANDARD ruling 2026-10-26](../quality/dependency-ruling-2026-10-26.md) | Replace with git fetch/checkout only after candidate revision, history and credential-cleanup parity. |
| `action:actions/download-artifact` | CI/supply chain | CI/supply chain: `.github/workflows/platform.yml` | [Delegated STANDARD ruling 2026-10-26](../quality/dependency-ruling-2026-10-26.md) | Replace only after candidate-bound artifact selection and downstream-job integrity checks have parity. |
| `action:actions/setup-node` | CI/supply chain | CI/supply chain: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/platform.yml` | [Delegated STANDARD ruling 2026-10-26](../quality/dependency-ruling-2026-10-26.md) | Replace only after the pinned Node runtime and npm cache behavior are supplied by the runner. |
| `action:actions/upload-artifact` | CI/supply chain | CI/supply chain: `.github/workflows/platform.yml` | [Delegated STANDARD ruling 2026-10-26](../quality/dependency-ruling-2026-10-26.md) | Replace only after artifact integrity, retention and downstream-job availability have parity. |

| `ci-tool:Node.js` | build/tooling | build/tooling: `package.json` | [Delegated STANDARD ruling 2026-10-26](../quality/dependency-ruling-2026-10-26.md) | Replace the script runtime only after build, generation and gate parity; separately pin the CI major rather than expanding the current range. |
| `npm:@playwright/test` | test | test: `console-react` | [Owner base approval 2026-10-26](../quality/dependency-ruling-2026-10-26.md) | Replace only after browser assertions, isolation, traces and journey coverage have parity. |

| `npm:react` | web: UI | web: UI: `@console/web` | [Owner base approval 2026-10-26](../quality/dependency-ruling-2026-10-26.md) | Replace the renderer only after state, component, accessibility and navigation parity; regenerate the lock and register. |
| `npm:react-dom` | web: UI | web: UI: `@console/web` | [Delegated STANDARD ruling 2026-10-26](../quality/dependency-ruling-2026-10-26.md) | Replace the DOM root only with the renderer after mounting, unmounting and browser event parity. |

No other dependency is approved by this map. Proposed choices and the unresolved owner queue remain in the register; a manifest, lock, licence allowlist or historical comment is not a ruling.
